segments.he: בַּשְּׁלִישִׁית פָּרָה אֲדוּמָּה, וּמַפְטִירִין ״וְזָרַקְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם״. וְאֵי זוֹ הִיא שַׁבָּת שְׁלִישִׁית — כֹּל שֶׁסְּמוּכָה לְפוּרִים מֵאַחֲרֶיהָ. בָּרְבִיעִית הַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, וּמַפְטִירִין ״כֹּה אָמַר ה׳ [אֱלֹהִים] בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ״.
segments.en: «On the third» Shabbat, they read the portion of «the Red Heifer [Para], and they read as the haftara» the portion of «“Then will I sprinkle» clean water «upon you”» (Ezekiel 36:25–38). «And which is the third Shabbat? That which is adjacent to Purim and after it. On the fourth» Shabbat, they read the portion of «“This month [haḥodesh]» shall be for you,” «and they read as the haftara» the portion of «“Thus says the Lord God: In the first month, on the first day of the month”» (Ezekiel 45:18–46:18).

segments.he: וְאֵיזוֹ הִיא שַׁבָּת רְבִיעִית — כֹּל שֶׁחָל רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן לִהְיוֹת בְּתוֹכָהּ, וַאֲפִילּוּ בְּעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת.
segments.en: «And which is the fourth Shabbat?» The Shabbat of «whichever» week «during which the New Moon of Nisan occurs, and» this is the case «even» if it occurs «on Friday.»

moves.summary: the baraita continues with the third and fourth Shabbatot

positions.claim: the third Shabbat is the one adjacent to Purim after it; the fourth is the week in which Rosh Hodesh Nisan falls, even on Friday
